title: Portal Chats: the Chats tab shows all chats, newest first
text: A conversation with a pin or a What's New note used to disappear from the Chats tab. Now Chats lists every conversation where a person wrote, from the newest message to the oldest. Pinned and What's New keep their own tabs.
points: Pinned conversations are in Chats, in date order
Conversations with a What's New note are in Chats too
Automatic-notice-only conversations stay out of Chats

steps.name: Open Portal Chats
steps.detail: The list opens on the Chats tab.

steps.name: Read the list top to bottom
steps.detail: Newest message first, pinned or not.
